description: A floating action button pinned to the bottom corner, with an optional label and speed-dial actions.
overview:
`Fab` is a round accent `Pressable` rendered through a portal and pinned to the bottom-end corner of the screen, above the safe-area insets. It comes in `default` and `lg` sizes, and becomes an extended pill when you pass a `label`.

When it has `FabAction` children, pressing it opens a speed dial: a scrim dims the screen and the actions rise above the button one after another. The plus icon rotates 45 degrees into a close mark; other icons swap to an X.
usage:
Use the default plus icon or pass any Phosphor icon to `icon`. Give an icon-only button an `accessibilityLabel`.

For a speed dial, add `FabAction` children with an `icon` and an optional text label. Pressing an action calls its `onPress` and closes the dial. Tapping the scrim or pressing the Android back button also closes it. Use `open`, `defaultOpen` and `onOpenChange` to control it.

Pass `portalHost` to render into a named portal host.

examples.Large: The `lg` size with a custom icon.
examples.SpeedDialOpen: A speed dial that starts open.
examples.SpeedDialClosed: A speed dial that opens on press.
examples.Controlled: A speed dial controlled with `open` and `onOpenChange`.

parts.Fab: Floating button that also hosts the speed dial.
parts.FabAction: One action in the speed dial, with an icon and optional label.

Fab.icon: Phosphor icon component. Defaults to a plus.
Fab.label: Text or node shown beside the icon.
Fab.onOpenChange: Called when the speed dial opens or closes.
Fab.portalHost: Name of the portal host to render into.

FabAction.icon: Phosphor icon component for the action.

accessibility:
- The button and each action have the `button` role.
- With actions, the button reports its `expanded` state.
- The VoiceOver escape gesture and the Android back button close the speed dial.
- The scrim is hidden from screen readers.
notes:
- Position follows the safe-area insets and flips sides in right-to-left layouts.
- Animations respect the system Reduce Motion setting.
- Uses `bg-accent`, `bg-surface-raised` and `bg-scrim` tokens; actions use a secondary surface in dark mode.
